children: Trader Bonk Guy’s portfolio has reached a new high of $27 million, with gains of $20.83 million over the past 30 days. According to ChainCatcher, he became the first user on the Fomo platform to reach a $27 million portfolio and remains the platform’s top trader.

His unrealized gains rose by $5.34 million in the past 24 hours and by $17.14 million over the past seven days. Bonk Guy said earlier that the trades and results were not his own doing and credited God for the outcome.

PONS, USELESS, and MARSCOIN accounted for most of the unrealized gains. Bonk Guy’s initial purchase of 10.9 million PONS tokens cost $67,700 and is now worth more than $10.27 million, representing a 150-fold return.

title: Bonk Guy's Portfolio Reaches $27 Million on Fomo Platform
